source.title: Liebherr Mobilkran/Mobile Crane LTM 1100-5.2 Technische Daten / Technical Data (official Liebherr datasheet hosted by crane rental company TROST)
source.page: 4 (upper table, ref t_206_00032_00_000 / 00001_00_000); dimensions p.2; weights & hook blocks p.3; remarks near end of document

notes: Official Liebherr datasheet not available on liebherr.com (model discontinued; successor LTM 1110-5.2); PDF obtained from rental company TROST (Austria), Liebherr layout and table IDs. Datasheet has 12 boom lengths (11.5, 15.2, 19, 22.7, 26.4, 30.1, 33.9, 37.6, 41.3, 45, 48.8, 52 m); 10 stored, 15.2 m and 45 m omitted. Omitted 15.2 m column (radius 3.5-12 m): 65, 65.8, 65.3, 61.6, 53.3, 46.3, 40.2, 35.1, 31.2, 24.8 t. Omitted 45 m column (radius 7-44 m): 18.8, 18.1, 17.3, 16, 14.6, 13.2, 12, 10.9, 9.9, 9, 8.2, 7.5, 6.6, 5.9, 5.3, 4.8, 4.4, 4, 3.6 t. For 11.5 m the datasheet has a '* over rear' column (100 t @2.7 m, 94.4 @3, 86.1 @3.5, 77.9 @4, 71.1 @4.5, 65.3 @5, 55 @6, 47.1 @7, 40.9 @8, 35.8 @9) and a 360° column; the 360° column is stored, so the 2.7 m row is null for 11.5 m and the top 360° value is 82.6 t @3 m. Rated 100 t is over-rear at 2.7 m only. Within a column, capacity increases with radius only at the smallest radii of 19 m (61.5 t @3.5 m, 62 @4, 62.6 @4.5) and of the omitted 15.2 m column - as printed in the datasheet (boom-angle limited). Across a row, longer booms sometimes show slightly higher values than shorter ones (e.g. 20 m radius: 26.4 m = 12.5 t, 30.1 m = 12.9 t) - also as printed. The 2.7 m radius row is kept but is null in all stored 360° columns. An older Liebherr datasheet version (Sarens, TAB 171156/171161, max 95 t over rear at 3 m) has slightly different values; the newer TROST version (t_206 table, 100 t) was used. Datasheet remark 4: weight of hook block/hooks is part of the load and must be deducted from capacities (hook block 100 t = 1240 kg, 90.2 t = 700 kg, 59.1 t = 500 kg, 26.1 t = 450 kg, hook 8.8 t = 250 kg). Counterweight 35 t = 15 t basic + 20 t additional. Outrigger span from dimension drawing p.2: longitudinal 7361 mm (4577 + 2784; another chain 4275 + 3111 = 7386 mm is shown), transverse 7000 mm fully extended (5000 / 4500 mm intermediate). Operating weight for full crane operation not stated; datasheet gives total weight 60 t (5 x 12 t axle loads) with 11.5 t counterweight and double folding jib. Max outrigger support force not given in this datasheet. Max hook height not printed as a number for the main boom (graphical only), left null. A ±60° chart (over front/rear sector, slightly higher values at short radius) exists on the same page and was not used. DIMS (added 2026-09-24 from the dimension drawing p.2 of the same source PDF): overallLength_m = carrier length (bottom dimension chain); axle positions and slew centre are cumulative sums of that chain from the carrier front; height = column A, width = column B for standard 385/95 R 25 (14.00 R 25) tyres. wheelDiameter_m is a nominal value computed from the tyre designation (not on the drawing). Boom pivot height/offset not dimensioned (null). Slew centre 35 mm behind axle 4. Tail radius: R = 3972 mm (superstructure rear corner) and R = 3840 mm (rear centre) on the top view; the larger is stored. Overall length 13.746 m / 13.641 m (boom head to rear). Dimension reference corrected: the datasheet's bottom dimension chain starts at the front of the boom head (transport position, boom overhanging the cab), not at the carrier front bumper. overallLength_m is now the carrier length (front bumper to rear) and axlePositions_m / slewCentreFromFront_m are measured from the carrier front bumper; the boom head overhang ahead of the bumper is stored as boomOverhangFront_m = 1.741 m (overall transport length incl. boom = 13.34 m). Evidence (dimensions drawing p.2): chain 1741 | 11599 = 13340, carrier chain 2350 | 2500 | 1630 | 1615 | 1650 | 1854 = 11599; slew centre 35 behind 4th axle.
